Theme example sources and notices

The JSON files in this folder map these palettes to Filee's existing colour roles. They are optional documentation examples. The light/dark mappings and foreground adjustments are Filee-specific adaptations.

Example Palette source (fixed revision) License notice
Catppuccin catppuccin/palette 07d02aa1 MIT
Nord nordtheme/nord 1cef7160 MIT
Dracula / Alucard Classic dracula/draculatheme.com 88fbf0b3 MIT
Classic Monokai (VS Code) microsoft/vscode a383e086 MIT

Nord's surface roles follow its colour guidelines. Dracula's values follow its specification; the MIT notice below is from its community-port template. The Monokai example uses the classic palette from VS Code, without Monokai Pro assets.

Foreground adjustments

The following secondary/status colours differ from the source palettes. Each is blended towards white in the dark variant, or black in the light variant, in 1% steps until its contrast is at least 4.5:1 on all three example backgrounds (page, surface, surfaceAlt). Other colours are direct role mappings. This covers these foreground/background pairs, not all controls, accent-derived colours or user edits.
